grammar.label: object pronouns
grammar.form: me, you, him, her, it, us, them

explanation.en: Use these after a verb or a preposition: I like him. Come with me.
explanation.uz: Fe'ldan yoki predlogdan keyin ishlatiladi: I like him. Come with me.

l1_notes.uz: O'zbekchada to'ldiruvchi tushib qolishi mumkin ('Yoqtiraman'); ingliz tilida 'it' ni qo'shish shart: 'I like it'.

explanation.en: Very and really make an adjective stronger. Too means more than you want — it is negative.
explanation.uz: very va really sifatni kuchaytiradi. 'too' esa 'keragidan ortiq' degani — salbiy ma'no.

l1_notes.uz: 'too' = 'juda' EMAS, 'keragidan ortiq'. 'juda' → 'very'. Bu juda ko'p uchraydigan xato.

grammar.label: coordination — and, but, or, so, because

explanation.en: and adds, but contrasts, or gives a choice, so gives a result, because gives a reason.
explanation.uz: and — qo'shadi, but — qarama-qarshi qo'yadi, or — tanlov, so — natija, because — sabab.

grammar.positive_example: I like music, but I don't like films.
grammar.negative_example: Although I like music, but I don't like films.

l1_notes.uz: O'zbekchada 'garchi … lekin' juft ishlatiladi; ingliz tilida faqat BITTASI bo'lishi kerak.
